verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms Bolt runs actual Node servers, browser console, and lets users edit code directly while building (bolt-gh-2, bolt-gh-3, bolt-docs-1/3/17), and community reports describe building and testing functional apps within minutes before any deploy (bolt-comm-4, bolt-comm-9, bolt-comm-10), implying an interactive preview loop. However no evidence explicitly documents a dedicated 'live preview' pane or iframe UI element separate from the running environment. Missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation/screenshots of a live preview panel, and independent confirmation of real-time preview interaction distinct from deployment.
